title: Tube Bend Length Formula: Arc, Tangent and Cut Length Math
excerpt: The tube bend length formula made easy: arc length, tangent length and cut length, with worked examples for one bend, hoops and bumpers.

notes: Educational formula guide. All arithmetic (tangent/arc/deduction table for 15-135 degrees, constants comparison, Examples 1-5 and the marking table) was computed in Python and rounded at the end; fractions are nearest 1/16. Direct page fetches were blocked by the network proxy in this session, so facts come from search-result text and the kit fact table. Please re-check: (1) Stainless Headers' 0.01745 constant and the ~1/4 in trim suggestion on the J-bend optimizer page; (2) Rogue Fab Bending 101 'bend offset' definition and the note that its offset tables are being updated (the page said so in search results); (3) The Fabricator line on springback/radial growth. Not used because unverified: Baileigh RDB-480 manual 9.45 in example, Rogue Fab '0.105 in per degree' figure (search attributed it to a third-party page). The Wixey listing gave 0.1 degree resolution; accuracy figures were not stated in the article because search summaries were unclear. The 'gain'/'take-up' terms are mentioned only as inconsistently used.
